about: stagewright wind-tunnel environment. Values are the stage contract recorded in stagewright's CLAUDE.md: Z-up, centimeters, 60 time codes per second, payload root /Environment, and the blueprint flow domain (X -144..144, Y -650..430, Z -4..248 cm) inside the environment's axis-aligned bound. Each component region must sit inside that component's axis-aligned bound. They come from the geometry spec in stagewright's docs/plan.md, with the X centring and the hall's base at Z 0 from tools/build_env.py: the plenum hall (about 2400 wide, Y -1600..1700, 1200 high), the tunnel from the collector at Y -1100 to the upstream end of the nozzle body at Y +1575 across the 650 nozzle exit width, and the floor under the 1000 turntable centred on Y 93. The tunnel's height range (the flow domain's, which the spec requires to sit inside the jet) and the floor's (domain floor to floor top) are thresholds chosen from the spec, not declared component heights.
